implementation_summary: Closes the five check-round defects in src/codemie/service/conversation/a2ui_intake.py. NEW-1 (compile bomb): the `regex` match timeout bounds MATCHING only -- compilation runs first and is not interruptible, so nested bounded quantifiers (whose expanded program size is the product of the repeat counts) hang the worker regardless of the 512-char pattern cap. Compilation now gets its own budget: `_regex_expansion_size` statically scans the pattern (one node per literal atom, `[...]` class as one atom, each group multiplied by the bounded repeat applied to it, `*`/`+`/`?` counted as loops rather than expansions, early-out at the ceiling) and `_match_field_regex` raises 422 'validation pattern is too complex' BEFORE calling regex.fullmatch when the estimate exceeds A2UI_MAX_REGEX_EXPANSION=50_000. Option (b) (static analysis) was chosen over (a) (compile in a killable process): a subprocess per submitted field costs tens of ms of fork/spawn, adds a failure mode inside a threaded ASGI worker, and on macOS spawn cannot be killed before the interpreter boots, whereas the scan is deterministic, allocation-free and measured at 2-11 microseconds; bounded repeats are the only construct that expands the compiled program superlinearly, and the existing 512-char length cap plus the 0.1 s match timeout still cover the remaining (linear / backtracking) cost. Budget calibration measured on this dependency set: 8k expansion -> <1 ms compile, 160k -> ~18 ms, 3.2M -> ~1.4 s, 64M -> 79.65 s; a sweep of adversarial 512-char patterns that PASS the gate (250-deep nesting, 100-way alternation, 100 lookaheads, 200 backrefs, `[a-zA-Z0-9_]{4096}`, `\p{L}{4096}`, `((a?){100}){100}`) compiles in 0.35-3.63 ms. NEW-2 (action.name): the name is now capped at A2UI_MAX_ACTION_NAME_LEN=128 BEFORE the surface is consulted (the surface that 'offers' a name is itself agent-authored, so vocabulary matching cannot license 58 kB of injected text), and a surface that declares no Button action.event.name is now rejected outright ('Surface offers no action to submit') instead of accepting any name: Button is the only Basic Catalog component carrying an `action` (verified against the catalog schema) and the renderer dispatches actions only from the SDK's Button handler (codemie-ui useA2uiSurface.ts -> ChatA2uiBlock.tsx -> chatGenerationStore.submitA2uiAction is the single submit path), so such a surface has no legitimate answer path and any action on it is client-forged. NEW-3 (nested paths): `_data_model_bindings` now returns every bound path keyed by its segment tuple (paths deeper than A2UI_MAX_BINDING_DEPTH=16 are dropped, which also bounds the walk over client input), and `_validate_bound_subtree` descends the submitted subtree -- an exact binding validates the leaf through the owning component, an interior node may only carry branches the surface declared (anything else is a 422 'Unknown A2UI data model key' naming the full path). Descending was preferred over rejecting nested bindings, because a nested binding is legal A2UI the agent may author and rejecting it would make such a surface unanswerable; descent generalises the flat case instead. NEW-4 (timezone): `_validate_datetime_value` normalises both sides with `_as_utc` (naive read as UTC) before comparing, so a 'Z' or '+05:00' suffix can no longer switch the declared min/max off; the datetime-vs-time kind mismatch is still skipped and now documented as a surface-authoring mismatch rather than a user-controlled bypass. NEW-5 (null): the `value is not None` short-circuit is gone -- null is validated like any other value and rejected by the component's type rule, because emptiness on this protocol is expressed as "", [] or false (the existing 'cleared values' test still passes). Hygiene: the pyproject.toml comment justifying the `regex` dependency now points at service/conversation/a2ui_intake.py instead of the deleted core/interactive.py.
